title: order_event
description: An order transitioning state in the checkout service. Produced to topic orders.v1.

x-contract.key_rationale: Partitioning by merchant keeps every event for one aggregation key on one partition, so a single consumer instance owns the whole window for that key and no cross-partition coordination is needed.
x-contract.ordering_guarantee: per partition, i.e. per merchant_id - NOT global
x-contract.delivery_guarantee: at-least-once from the producer; duplicates are expected and are the consumer's problem

event_id.description: Unique per logical event. A retry of the same event MUST reuse this id - it is the deduplication key.

occurred_at.description: Event time, set by the producer, UTC. This is what windows are built from - never the time we received it.

ingested_at.description: Optional producer-side send time. Used only to measure lateness, never to assign windows.

amount_minor.description: Amount in minor units (cents). Integer on purpose: floats do not sum reproducibly.
